card.name: Freedom after rights and prosperity
card.fires_on: The word freedom(s) in patriotic phrases such as 'rights and freedoms' or 'our freedom'. It also fires weakly on a few unrelated spots, like the middle of 'eukaryotes' and 'Win2K'.

modes.label: Freedom in civic phrases
modes.description: Freedom or freedoms after 'rights and', 'prosperity and', or 'our', in talk of troops and citizenship.
modes.example: Somewhere after 911- many patriotic Americans seem to have embraced the idea that “The Troops” are fighting to protect our rights and<< freedoms>>- as if the US Armed Forces function

modes.label: Partway through technical terms
modes.description: The middle of 'eukaryotes' or the 'K' in Win2K server names.

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted tokens are a mix of Chinese and English words about structure and modernity.
card.plain: It lights up on the word 'freedom' in patriotic phrases, and oddly on a few technical terms like eukaryotes and Win2K.
